note: Why → Summary. Recaps are written by hand (Claude) from Randy's own reviews; refresh each month. Music: Google Doc 'Monthly Music Review'. Marvel: TickTick Marvel list → 'Monthly Reviews' section (e.g. 'Marvel-August 2026 Review').

reviews.title: Music
reviews.gist: A packed month (job search, income routines, digital reorganizing, finances) left little room for the open, vulnerable headspace sessions need. The win: Music Hub got a big upgrade. Now it's about actually using it.

points.label: Guitar
points.text: A real, rooted connection. Barre chords and strumming still need work, and the new guitar section on the site is built for that. Songwriting comes easily on guitar.

points.label: Songwriting & vocals
points.text: Still the biggest pull, a calling to perform. Perfectionism and judging your own delivery get in the way. The loop is: start, get lost, deliver nothing, feel upset, skip next time. You picked up a book on how to write songs.

points.label: Ableton
points.text: Your workflow is optimized and you're still learning mastering. Next direction: cohesion, where every element serves one vision instead of being a mix of everything you like.

carry: Record some guitar and sing over it
Use the songwriting book to break the start-and-stall loop
Build tracks around one vision; keep learning mastering

reviews.title: Marvel
reviews.monthNote: Latest review on file (written in September). No September review yet.
reviews.gist: Marvel is doing better but needs more stimulation. Your attention has been stretched while you work toward a home that's better for you both.

points.label: Training
points.text: Research a calm-down command other than "place". He reads you well, but otherwise winds himself up.

points.label: Impulses
points.text: Improving, and you want that to come from understanding, not fear. He may not know the ladder yet.

points.label: Grooming
points.text: Doing it yourself for now (baths, brushing). He likes being groomed. The vac brush is there, it just needs using.

points.label: Walks
points.text: He needs more. His pulling makes brisk walks overwhelming, and you worry about reinforcing bad habits. He loves to learn, so figure out what to teach him.

carry: Find a calm-down command to train
Research leash and pulling work for walks
Groom regularly with the vac brush
Pick new things to teach him

goalsIntro: Your goals across six areas. The names update live from the Life and Present Goals sheet; the one-line summaries were written Oct 8.

categoryGists.physical: Fuel, rest and care for your body: 170g protein, 3–4 bottles of water, whole foods, 7–8 hours of sleep, vitamins and self-care.
categoryGists.mental: A calm, aware mind: reading, journaling as reflection, daily Healthy Minds, clean spaces, and grounding/alignment reminders.
categoryGists.connection: Being present with people and with Marvel: plan lunches and experiences, be a villager in friendships, take pictures, train Marvel and audit monthly.
categoryGists.financial: Independence: build credit, grow your moving-forward savings, and snowball the material odds and ends to done.
categoryGists.spiritual: Creative expression and storytelling through guitar, vocals and production.
categoryGists.upkeep: Keep life running: home and possessions, digital systems, admin, money admin and personal logistics.
